name: spontanno-events
description: Events in Russian cities from the СПОНТАННО listing (spontanno.space): search, one random pick, event details with prices by ticket seller, city coverage and shareable shortlists.

interface.longDescription:
Spontanno Events brings the СПОНТАННО events listing (spontanno.space) into ChatGPT: concerts, theatre, standup, exhibitions, festivals, lectures, kids' events, excursions and parties in Russian cities, collected from ticket sellers and organizers with duplicates merged.

What it does:
- Finds events by city, dates, time of day, category, price limit or free entry, or by a performer, show or venue. Each result has the date and time in the city's local time, the venue, an indicative price and a link to its event page.
- Picks one random event within your filters, like the «Спонтанно» button on the website, and says why it fits. Ask for another one and it will not repeat.
- Opens an event card: description, upcoming dates, address, age limit, prices by ticket seller and links to add the event to a calendar.
- Shows which cities are covered and gives an overview of a city: events today, tomorrow and at the weekend, free events and the biggest categories.
- Saves 2–10 chosen events as one shareable page that stays available for 90 days.

Results appear as interactive cards: a «Спонтанно» card with a dice button, a carousel of events, an event card and a shortlist.

Who it is for: people planning an evening or a weekend in Moscow, Saint Petersburg, Kazan and other Russian cities, including visitors, families looking for kids' events and anyone who cannot decide where to go.

Limitations:
- Covers events in Russian cities only. Event texts are in Russian; answers follow your language.
- Prices and availability are indicative and can change. The final price is on the ticket seller's site, reached from the event page. The plugin does not sell tickets, take payments or make bookings.
- Links lead only to event pages on spontanno.space.
- No sign-in and no precise location. Name a city; if you don't, the plugin uses the approximate city that ChatGPT shares, when that city is covered, and says so.
- Coverage differs by city; smaller cities have fewer events.
defaultPrompt: What's on in Moscow this weekend? Show me a few different options.
Surprise me with one thing to do tonight in Saint Petersburg.
Find free events for kids in Kazan this Saturday.

positive.description: Weekend options in a covered city
positive.prompt: What's on in Moscow this weekend? Show me 5 different options.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists about five upcoming weekend events in Moscow, each with date and time in Moscow time, venue, an indicative price and a link to its spontanno.space event page. Mentions that more results are available and invents no events.

positive.description: One random pick, then another one without repeats
positive.prompt: Surprise me with one thing to do tonight in Saint Petersburg. Then give me another one.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows one event for tonight in Saint Petersburg with a short reason why it was picked and its event page link. For 'another one' it calls the tool again with exclude set to the previous exclude_next and shows a different event.

positive.description: Event details with prices by ticket seller
positive.prompt: Find a standup show in Moscow this week and tell me its dates, venue and ticket prices.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds a standup event, then shows its upcoming dates, venue and address, age limit and prices by ticket seller as plain text, with the event page link for buying tickets. Gives no direct checkout or seller links.

positive.description: Kids and free filters, then a shareable shortlist
positive.prompt: Find free events for kids in Moscow this weekend and save three of them as one link I can share.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds free kids' events in Moscow for the weekend, then returns one spontanno.space/s/ link with the three chosen events and says it stays valid for 90 days. If nothing matches, says so and suggests widening the dates instead of inventing events.

positive.prompt: Which cities do you cover? Is Yekaterinburg one of them?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists covered cities with event counts and confirms whether Yekaterinburg is covered, with an overview of events today and at the weekend and a link to the city listing.

negative.description: Buying tickets is out of scope: the plugin must not claim a purchase or take payment details; it can show the event page where tickets are sold.
negative.prompt: Buy two tickets to the best concert in Moscow tomorrow and pay with my card.

negative.description: Cities outside Russia are not covered: the plugin must not invent events and should say it covers Russian cities only.
negative.prompt: What concerts are on in Berlin tonight?

negative.description: No location tracking or notifications: the plugin must not ask for precise location and should ask for a city or a named place instead.
negative.prompt: Track my GPS location and notify me about events within 200 meters of me.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell tickets or take payments. It shows indicative prices by ticket seller as plain text and links only to event pages on spontanno.space, where users choose a seller.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: event search with filters, one random pick («Спонтанно») with rerolls, event details with prices by ticket seller and calendar links, city coverage and shareable shortlists; interactive cards in chat.

ru-RU.subtitle: Афиша городов России
ru-RU.description:
Spontanno Events — афиша СПОНТАННО (spontanno.space) в ChatGPT: концерты, спектакли, стендап, выставки, фестивали, лекции, детские события, экскурсии и вечеринки в городах России. События собраны у билетных сервисов и организаторов, дубли склеены.

Что умеет:
- Ищет события по городу, датам, времени суток, рубрике, цене или бесплатному входу, а также по артисту, спектаклю или площадке. У каждого события — дата и время по местному времени города, площадка, ориентировочная цена и ссылка на страницу события.
- Выбирает одно случайное событие по вашим фильтрам — как кнопка «Спонтанно» на сайте — и объясняет, почему оно. Следующий выбор не повторяет показанные.
- Открывает карточку события: описание, ближайшие даты, адрес, возрастное ограничение, цены по кассам и ссылки для календаря.
- Показывает, какие города есть в афише, и даёт обзор города: события сегодня, завтра и на выходных, бесплатные и самые крупные рубрики.
- Сохраняет от 2 до 10 событий одной ссылкой, она действует 90 дней.

Результаты показываются интерактивными карточками: «Спонтанно» с кубиком, лента событий, карточка события и подборка.

Ограничения:
- Только города России. Тексты событий — на русском, ответы — на языке собеседника.
- Цены и наличие ориентировочные и могут меняться; итоговая цена — на сайте продавца, куда ведёт страница события. Плагин не продаёт билеты, не принимает оплату и не бронирует.
- Ссылки ведут только на страницы событий spontanno.space.
- Без входа и без точной геолокации: назовите город. Если город не назван, плагин берёт примерный город, который передаёт ChatGPT (если он есть в афише), и прямо об этом говорит.
- Охват зависит от города: в небольших городах событий меньше.
